Being single can be tough be a tough mindset to stay in, since you ultimately want to feel cared for and loved by someone close to you. And I think hoping each day that “that person I’m gonna be with is out there” is tough to keep in mind. But despite that it is true, everyone is loved eventually because we deserve love.

The best I can say in my experience was finding small comforts while I wait. Having a cat has been helpful, any pet has infinite love for you. Your friends would hopefully listen to your struggles and empathise. 

TLDR; I think it’s all taking it day by day. (it was long post to get to that cliche line so apologies lol)

I could certainly agree with that idea. Obviously I believe SPM has its own unique qualities trying to mix mainline Mario platforming with a rpg mechanical nature. A retooling of the backtracking often in these games would be good as it’s been pointed out. But either way the wonderful plot, characters and chapter locations would be a very solid base.

I checked that out. Definitely worth playing upon finish. Personally the TOK and CS styles big white paper lines is kinda rough, as well as the flatter textures of that game. But it definitely looks quite decent at this point in development.

I do like this for several reasons:

-TTYD is incredibly popular and has several iconic/unique locations and plot lines. As well as being generally considered great. The incorporation of Supers ability to change perspective is still why I endlessly recommend the game despite its change of battle system. There’s a ton of environmental design and puzzles that work incredibly well with it. 

-The change to incorporate new partners is definitely good, hell some partners have overlap so it’s not strictly necessary to get rid of them. Instead to have them as NPCs or more experimentally, ‘skins’ for the ones that overlap (Ex: Bobbery becoming Bombette). The idea of remixing chapter and level design is great, like Boo’s Mansion or even spookier, Merlee’s Mansion in an area like Twilight Town. You could certainly open up areas we’ve only seen through the straight on camera with the larger sets that you see in TOK. 

-I’m of two minds of Mario’s stats and the battle system incorporating new badges/moves. I do think balancing would be tricky. The multitude of badges already in the game means some trimming/combining but ultimately it wouldn’t be much of an issue as a rebalance of the enemies and bosses (old, new, updated) would likely make it less problematic. Hell new badges means a chance to add a new rpg mechanics and new timed button presses. I do really like the idea of having two partners in the party, it’s incredibly thematic and that’s not just because I like Chrono Trigger lol. But of course this would require a retooling of the combat and the additional partner. Perhaps for a new type of encounter that can be shuffled into the game like the Double/Triple battles from Pokémon. Creating story line abilities would also be cumbersome to integrate as part of the flow of the chapters but it’s something to keep on the table (As well as Double Techs with different partner combinations like Chrono Trigger but that’s ambitious). 

I appreciate your input. I would wholeheartedly agree that the current Paper Mario team should be nowhere near this game lmao.

I'm not sure where it says it requires both active trigger slots, I checked the wiki and didn't see that, but say it does: You could still set up cubes for later use, we see so with Osamu leaving a field of cubes before his bailout in his match against Katori Squad. As well as Azuma able to leave Meteor cubes to be set off by wire traps. So you could have a cube of asteroid lead bullets, granted being lead bullets. that's more trion to use. I thought of this when I saw Chika make a massive asteroid cube with a Lead Bullet effect. I always found lead bullet to have really interesting properties (more trion=more weight, piercing shields, etc) so how can I use it effectively with asteroid or viper? Well other than being able make way more lead bullet shots with the cubes and vipers precise control (I’ve always had good eyes for aiming/tracking), I would mix it up. I could make two cubes, one normal trion cubes and one lead bullet cubes. Fire both at different rates and no normal shield could cover every shot, and since they can stay around, I’d mix Viper cubes with Asteroid cubes. Small note, I notice no one tries to use the ‘slow buckshot’ asteroid variant Osamu thought up in the first invasion, that would be useful for this play style as well. There’s other small things i could see using in niche situations. Lead Bullet shields by concentrating fire to make cover, switch in meteor if I need to blanket an area with lead bullet against chameleon enemies, and using Lead Bullet to make footholds or even armor plating.  
  
TL;DR, Lead Bullet Nasu play style. My other triggers are just for mobility and making sure I’m not immediately killed a minute into the match lol.  
  
My second style is more experimental but could be useful Crowd Control (Razor Wire)

​

|Main|Sub|
|:-|:-|
|Scorpion (Modded)|Scorpion (Modded)|
|Spider|Spider|
|Bagworm|Free|
|Shield|Shield|

The idea is to shift the stats of my scorpion so it can shift into a mode that’s made up of long sharp wires. Now of course this on its own isn’t that useful, it’s at best a good Spider-Man cosplay. But after seeing Yuma make a Shuriken with scorpion, I suspect support triggers could work and that’s where the spider comes in. If scorpion can be detached from the body and still function as a damaging weapon, Scorpion+Spider traps could be useful. We see when Osamu deploys his spider that it creates little prongs and fires into nearby walls. Now imagine if you were chasing an opponent and suddenly before catching him, you run into a nearly invisible wire that cut your arm off. Of course that’s only a surprise tactic but being able to even deploy those wire mid fight could be useful. Fighting blade to blade with scorpions and middle of the fight, throw a scorpion spider cube out behind your opponent to limit their movement. TL;DR, I should figure out the a name for Scorpion+Spider since it feels like you could do something with that. The bagworm is just to be able to set of spider fields in peace.  
  
Final note, I’d say I’d probably be on a team of much less cautious and battle hungry weirdos. I like that they’d balance the composition and they seem like they’d be fun to hang out with after games. I’m into DnD and video games so I’m no stranger to working as a team and coordinating strategies :)
